cli.help_convert_dataset:
usage: convert_dataset.py [-h] [--split SPLIT] [--workers WORKERS]
                          [--discontinuity-filter] [--jump-window {frame,row}]
                          [--jump-isolated-step-m JUMP_ISOLATED_STEP_M]
                          raw_root out_root

positional arguments:
  raw_root
  out_root

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --split SPLIT
  --workers WORKERS
  --discontinuity-filter
                        v2b: drop raw MASt3R silent jumps
                        (pose_filter.discontinuity_filter)
  --jump-window {frame,row}
  --jump-isolated-step-m JUMP_ISOLATED_STEP_M
cli.help_export_lerobot:
usage: export_lerobot.py [-h] [--name NAME] [--workers WORKERS]
                         [--splits [SPLITS ...]]
                         processed out

positional arguments:
  processed
  out

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME
  --workers WORKERS
  --splits [SPLITS ...]
cli.help_handumi_export:
usage: handumi_export.py [-h] --out OUT [--episodes [EPISODES ...]]
                         [--workers WORKERS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
  --episodes [EPISODES ...]
  --workers WORKERS

contract.action_contract: current_anchor_relative: A_k = inv(T(t)) @ T(t + k*UMI_DT), k = 1..16, raw-trajectory interpolation
contract.action_layout: [L xyz3 rot6d6 g | R xyz3 rot6d6 g | AUX12 = 0]
contract.state_contract: relcart20_task_anchor: per arm inv(T(t_task_start)) @ T(t); layout [L pose9 | R pose9 | gL | gR]
contract.state_prevrel_contract: diagnostic only: per arm inv(T(t)) @ T(t - UMI_DT); layout [L pose9 g | R pose9 g]
contract.rotation_representation: rot6d, first two ROWS of R (umi pose_util.mat_to_rot6d)
contract.gripper_representation: continuous aperture, 0 = closed, 1 = open (caliper mm / 80 mm)
